enrichment.summary: Configures Safe Links to scan and verify URLs in emails, Teams messages, and Office applications at the time of click, blocking access to malicious sites.
enrichment.rationale: Protects users from phishing attacks and malicious links by ensuring URLs are scanned and verified before access, minimising the risk of security breaches.
enrichment.licensing: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 1 (Microsoft 365 E5)
